_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. A Doom project chooses its game (Chimera's System). The IWAD of that game, in any release, is the firmware. The project's PWADs and DeHackEd patches are listed here, in the order the engine loads them (-file first, then -deh).

slots.title: PWADs and patches
slots.help: The WADs (.wad) and DeHackEd patches (.deh, .bex) of the mod, in the order they are loaded. Where two WADs hold the same lump, the later one wins. Give none to play the game itself.
